_comment: Alternative to the hard block. PATCH /mcp-servers/{id}/tools/issue_write/policy. Marks issue_write as a write-side-effect tool that requires approval. NOTE: requires_approval gates the tool when it runs inside a workflow (via the human-approval node); it is NOT enforced on the direct Playground invoke path, which only honors allowed:false. For a true read-only explorer, prefer the .block.policy.json. Strip this _comment before sending.
